# Stocks
Watchlist quotes and quick ticker lookup.
> **Status:** planned — not yet functional. See [PLAN.md](PLAN.md).
## Usage
Watchlist quotes and quick ticker lookup via the `stock` keyword.
![Stocks results in Alfred](images/stock.png)
* <kbd>↩</kbd> Primary action. * <kbd>⌘</kbd><kbd>↩</kbd> Secondary action. * <kbd>⌘</kbd><kbd>Y</kbd> Quick Look.
Every keyword can be changed in the Workflow’s Configuration.
## Development
```bash ./build.sh # -> dist/alfred-stocks-<version>.alfredworkflow ```
## AI disclosure
This workflow is developed with the help of Claude (Anthropic), an AI assistant. All code is reviewed and tested by the author.
